about: Curated English YouTube videos for each week of the curriculum. Source of truth for the Moodle 'Watch' pages and the GitHub phase pages. Rules: English audio and captions, embeddable, under 30 minutes unless marked optional, 2025-2026 for LLM topics, official channels first. Checked by lms/check_videos.py.
